Eligible strategies made +68.3 bps a trade in turbulent sessions and +42.7 in calm ones (t +1.32), validation.

ridge-250's top-decile forecasts averaged +7.5 bps; the realised result was +2.0 bps (about 3.7× too optimistic).

Keeping positions cut turnover by 58% and changed net by −0.78 bps a session (L6 vs L8), validation.
At a €10,000 book the €1 fee alone took 0.7% a year from L2; fee-aware breadth chose 1 name on 100%, 2 on 0%, 3 on 0% of trading sessions (validation).
Meta trust in ensemble moved from 24% to 24% in 20 sessions; zero 20% → 18%.
ridge-250 has predicted less lately: IC +0.002 over 60 sessions against +0.018 over 250.

In history, the equal-weight line of today's index members beat the accumulating Europe ETF by 3.1% a year even without dividends. The gap mixes survivorship with equal weighting and a different universe (the ETF includes the UK and Switzerland), so it hints at how much today's members flatter history but does not measure it.
